settings.title: Settings
settings.not_configured_description: Enter the Matrix and Discord settings below to start the bridge.
settings.how_description: Call the bot from Element Web or Element Desktop in the unencrypted room it creates for you. The bot joins the Discord voice channel and bridges the audio both ways; hanging up makes it leave. Element X is not supported.
settings.matrix_description: Use a separate Matrix account for the bot. Only calls from the allowed user are accepted.
settings.room_name_helper: Name of the unencrypted room the bot creates for you
settings.discord_description: The bot needs the View Channel, Connect and Speak permissions in the voice channel. Copy the IDs with Developer Mode enabled in Discord.
settings.token_set_helper: A token is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.network_description: The call audio between your Matrix client and the bridge uses the UDP ports {ports} of this node, which are open in the firewall. Behind NAT, forward these ports and enter the public IP address, or rely on the TURN server of the homeserver.
settings.public_ip_helper: Advertised to your Matrix client for the call audio
settings.invalid_homeserver_url: Must be an http:// or https:// URL, like https://matrix.example.org
settings.invalid_matrix_user: Must be a Matrix user ID, like @me:example.org
settings.invalid_discord_id: Must be a Discord ID (17 to 20 digits)
settings.invalid_token: Must not contain spaces or line breaks
settings.invalid_room_name: Must be 1 to 100 characters on one line
settings.invalid_ip_address: Must be an IPv4 or IPv6 address
